title: Add 1 to 100 Like Gauss
summary: Pair the numbers from both ends to make equal sums.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: What is 1 plus 2 plus 3 and so on up to 100?
Do not add one by one.
points: What is 1 plus 2 plus 3 and so on up to 100?

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: Look at pairs: the first and last numbers together, the second and second last together.
points: Look at pairs: the first and last numbers together, the second and second last together.

steps.title: The method: Pair them up
sentences: 1 plus 100 is 101. 2 plus 99 is 101. 3 plus 98 is 101.
points: 1 plus 100 is 101. 2 plus 99 is 101. 3 plus 98 is 101.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: The famous story says the young Carl Friedrich Gauss used this idea.
The shortcut is the count times the first plus last, divided by 2.

facts: The Gauss story may be partly legend, but the method is real.
